When dealing with a group of highly correlated variables, the LASSO tends to select only one variable from the group while ignoring the others.
The elastic net overcomes this limitation by adding a quadratic penalty term to the LASSO's penalty function.
This modification allows the elastic net to handle groups of correlated variables more effectively than the standard LASSO approach.
The LASSO tends to select only one variable from a group of highly correlated variables and ignore the others.
The elastic net overcomes the LASSO's limitation by adding a quadratic penalty term to the LASSO's penalty function.
The elastic net can include multiple correlated variables rather than just selecting a single representative.
The elastic net provides a more stable solution in high-dimensional settings where LASSO might saturate or arbitrarily pick variables.
